name: Fishmonger Vibert

intro.text: Spider crab, lobster, scallops and ormers, if you're lucky and licensed. I'd rather sell you a fish than fight you, but I'll do either.

win: Oh, you've netted me. Have a scallop on the house.
after: Ormers are a kind of abalone, a shell like a mother-of-pearl ear. You may only gather them on a few days a year, at the very lowest spring tides. Don't ask me where I get mine.
